steps.heading: Step 1 of 12
steps.title: Choose Your Class
steps.desc: Your class defines how you fight and survive.

cards.label: Warrior, frontline fighter, high strength and defense

parts.text: Crushes enemies through brute strength and iron will.

cards.label: Monk, spiritual striker, high agility

parts.text: Channels inner force. Moves like shadow, strikes like thunder.

cards.label: Assassin, shadow predator, very high agility and luck

parts.text: Strikes from darkness before prey can react.

cards.label: Paladin, divine guardian, high defense and faith

parts.text: Wields holy power to smite evil and shield against darkness.

cards.label: Naturalist, wild sage, high intelligence and luck

parts.text: Commands beasts and bends the wild to their cause.

cards.label: Sorcerer, arcane destroyer, very high intelligence but low defense

parts.text: Wields raw arcane chaos. Glass cannon — obliterates first.

cards.label: Necromancer, death mage, raises fallen enemies

parts.text: Raises fallen enemies as undead servants. Sacrifices HP for power. Benefits from death itself.

cards.label: Berserker, rage warrior, gets stronger at low health

parts.text: The lower the HP, the harder the hits. Below 25% HP becomes truly unstoppable.

cards.label: Bard, song weaver, support and buff class

parts.text: Empowers through music. Songs buff attacks, restore SP, and confuse enemies.

cards.label: Alchemist, potion crafter, transmutes items into power

parts.text: Crafts explosives and elixirs mid-combat. Transmutes gold into raw power.

cards.label: Blood Knight, sacrifices HP for massive damage

parts.text: Spends own HP to deal devastating damage. The more you sacrifice, the harder you strike.

cards.label: Druid, shapeshifter, switches between human beast and spirit forms

parts.text: Shifts between forms — human for balance, beast for raw power, spirit for healing.

cards.label: Warlock, dark pact maker, drains life from enemies

parts.text: Made a pact with something old. Drains life from every kill. High risk, high sustain.

cards.label: Death Knight, undead warrior, refuses to die

parts.text: Commands the boundary between life and death. Survives one killing blow per run.

cards.label: Ranger, swift hunter, bonus damage on first hit every combat, plus 15 percent flee chance

parts.text: Every combat opens with a devastating first strike — 75% bonus damage on the opening hit. Hard to catch, harder to kill.

cards.label: Sentinel, unbreakable wall, highest HP in the game, takes 25 percent less damage from all sources

parts.text: Highest HP of any class. Takes 25% less damage from all sources. Deals less damage in return. Built to outlast everything.

cards.label: Cleric, divine healer, potions heal triple

parts.text: Blessed by something above the dungeons. Potions heal triple but only one can be carried.

cards.label: Wizard, arcane scholar, highest SP lowest HP, reveals enemy stats on combat start

parts.text: Commands ancient spells. Fragile but devastating. Reveals enemy HP and attack range on first combat turn.

cards.label: Elementalist, elemental master, deals bonus damage to enemies weak to your element

parts.text: Commands fire, ice, and lightning. Enemies weak to your element take 25% bonus damage. Skills deal 15% more.

cards.label: VoidWalker, void entity, phases through attacks and strikes from the void

parts.text: Exists between dimensions. Can phase through attacks. Void spells hit harder. High risk, high reward playstyle.

cards.label: ShadowMage, shadow caster, magic damage from the darkness

parts.text: Draws power from darkness. Shadow spells ignore defense. Stronger at night and in deep dungeons.

cards.label: TimeMage, temporal mage, manipulates time in combat

parts.text: Bends time itself. Can slow enemies, repeat actions, and delay incoming damage. Mastery of the Time Stop spell.

cards.label: Shaman, spirit caller, summons ancestral spirits in combat

parts.text: Channels ancestral spirits. Spirits assist in combat, buff your attacks, and can curse enemies. Spiritual and physical power combined.

cards.label: Arcanist, pure arcane power, highest magic damage in the game

parts.text: The purest form of magic. No weapons, no armor — pure arcane force. Highest magic damage in the game. Extremely fragile.

cards.label: Human, adaptable, bonus to all stats
Elf, graceful, bonus agility and intelligence
Dwarf, unyielding, bonus strength and defense
Orc, savage, massive strength bonus reduced defense
Tiefling, infernal, bonus luck and intelligence
Shade, ethereal, bonus agility and luck
Vampire, drains HP on kill, starts with less HP

parts.text: Drain 5 HP per kill · −20% max HP

cards.label: Goblin, earns more gold, starts with bonus gold
Angel, extra life, heals on level up

parts.text: +1 extra life · Heal 15 HP on level up

cards.label: Demon, deals and takes more damage
Golem, high defense, immune to poison and freeze

parts.text: +5 defense · Immune to poison and freeze

cards.label: Halfling, small but lucky, 15 percent dodge chance
Dragonborn, dragon blood, 10 percent chance to deal bonus burn damage every hit
Gnome, arcane trickster, plus INT and LCK, skills cost less SP
Merfolk, aquatic, plus AGI, potions heal more, bonus in Sunken Archives

steps.heading: Step 3 of 12
steps.title: Choose Your Profession
steps.desc: Your past grants you a hidden edge.

cards.label: Blacksmith, bonus armor and weapon durability
Herbalist, potions twice as effective
Scholar, better trap and curse detection
Mercenary, start with extra gold and a weapon
Gravedigger, resistance to undead attacks
Thief, higher chance to find hidden loot
Pilgrim profession. Starts with a holy relic. Plus 15 percent XP gain.
Grave Robber profession. Starts with 50 gold. Enemies drop bonus loot.
Street Rat profession. Free Smoke Bomb skill. Better flee chance.
Warden profession. Starts with plus 3 defense. Immune to first debuff each floor.
Tinkerer profession. Starts with 2 potions. Skills cost less SP.

parts.text: Start with 2 potions · -2 SP per skill

steps.heading: Step 4 of 12
steps.title: Name Your Character
steps.desc: A name carved into dungeon walls endures longer than the flesh.

steps.heading: Step 5 of 12
steps.title: Choose Your Dungeon
steps.desc: Seven dungeons await. Complete each one to unlock the next. Each dungeon has unique enemies, atmosphere, and a final boss.

cards.label: Crypt of Malachar, unlocked, undead dungeon, 10 floors

parts.text: An ancient burial vault sealed shut with a warlord inside. Malachar refused to die. His generals, soldiers, and everything else that perished in his wars patrols the dark alongside him. They remember their oaths. They do not know why.

cards.label: The Ashbound Wastes, locked, fire dungeon, complete Crypt of Malachar to unlock

parts.text: A city called Vel Ashara was swallowed by fire three hundred years ago. The fire never went out. Something in it became aware. Explorers who descend into the ruins do not find ruins. They find something that is still burning and does not want to stop.
🔒 Complete Crypt of Malachar to unlock

cards.label: Frosthold Abyss, locked, ice dungeon, complete Ashbound Wastes to unlock

parts.text: Deep beneath frozen mountains, a mining expedition broke through into a cavern so large torchlight could not reach the far wall. The journals of every expedition sent since have returned to the surface. The explorers have not. The cold here is not a temperature. It is a presence.

cards.label: The Sunken Archives, locked, drowned library dungeon, complete Frosthold Abyss to unlock

parts.text: The greatest library ever built now sits under three hundred feet of dark water. The books are perfectly preserved. The archivists who refused to leave are also perfectly preserved. They have had a very long time to read everything. They did not like what they found.

cards.label: The Hollow, locked, horror dungeon, complete Sunken Archives to unlock

parts.text: A house that has been empty for a long time. It is not empty anymore. The things that live here now are not the things that lived here before. They remember the people who used to be here. They are waiting for them to come back. You are not who they are waiting for. They do not mind.
🔒 Complete The Sunken Archives to unlock

cards.label: The Whispering Forest, locked, cursed forest dungeon, complete The Hollow to unlock

parts.text: A witch was killed. Her curse consumes everything. Corruption rises as you descend — reach 100% and die instantly.

cards.label: The Infernal, locked. Requires 100 trophies to unlock. Tap to see your progress.

parts.text: Something stirs beyond the veil. A dungeon of pure darkness. Evil spirits. Void entities. Things that came from the dark. It cannot be entered — yet.
🔒 Locked — Tap to discover how to unlock

cards.label: The Abyssal Deep, locked. Complete The Infernal Descent to unlock.

parts.text: The deepest dungeon. The hardest boss. The Leviathan is not here to play. 800 HP. Four phases. It hits harder than anything you have faced. Bring everything you have. You will need it.

cards.label: The Shadow World, locked. Complete The Abyssal Deep to unlock.

parts.text: It has existed for 3000 years beneath a cursed forest. It does not obey your rules. The Shapeshifter waits at the end — wearing your face, using your skills, knowing your every move. Nothing that enters here leaves unchanged.
🔒 Complete The Abyssal Deep to unlock

steps.heading: Step 6 of 12
steps.title: Choose Your Fate
steps.desc: Your chosen fate cannot be altered once you descend.

cards.label: Wanderer, 3 lives, normal enemy damage, recommended for new players

parts.text: A cautious descent. For those still learning the dungeon.
Normal damage · 3 lives · Recommended for new players

cards.label: Ironblood, 1 life, 10 percent more enemy damage

parts.text: One mistake ends your run. The dungeon shows no mercy.
+10% enemy damage · 1 life · For confident players

cards.label: Condemned, 1 life, 25 percent more enemy damage

parts.text: Enemies hit harder. The dungeon has been waiting for you.

cards.label: Forsaken, 1 life, 50 percent more enemy damage, most never return

parts.text: Reserved for the truly damned. Most never return.

cards.label: Nightmare, 1 life, 75 percent more damage, exclusive enemies nowhere else in the game

parts.text: The dungeon twists into something wrong. Enemies that exist nowhere else. The boss has never been seen before.
+75% enemy damage · Exclusive enemies · Only for the fearless

cards.label: Insane mode. A sanity bar drains as you descend. At zero the dungeon ends. New enemies. Corrupted UI. Not recommended.

parts.text: The dungeon does not play fair at this level. Neither should you.
1 life · Sanity bar · Corrupted UI · Not for the faint of heart

cards.label: Endless mode. The dungeon never ends. Keep descending forever until you die. Your floor depth is your score.

parts.text: The dungeon never ends. No floor 10. No victory. Just how deep can you go? Your deepest floor is saved as your personal record.

cards.label: Hardcore Mode off. Normal gameplay.

parts.text: Normal lives. Death sends you back, not to deletion.

cards.label: Hardcore Mode on. One life. Death is permanent.

parts.text: One life. One chance. Deleted on death.

extras.text: Death is permanent. One life. If you die, your character is deleted forever. No second chances.

⚠ Warning — This Cannot Be Undone • You have one life. No extra lives. No resurrection. • If you die, your character is permanently deleted from save data. • No retry. No continue. No recovery. • Cloud saves will not restore a deleted hardcore character. If you are sure, continue. If not, select Standard above.

steps.heading: Step 7 of 12
steps.title: Choose Your Run Mode
steps.desc: How do you want to play? This shapes your entire experience.

cards.label: Classic Run. Start at level 1 every time. Die and start fresh. Traditional roguelike.

parts.text: • Every run is a fresh start
ROGUELIKE · CLASSIC · RECOMMENDED FOR NEW PLAYERS

cards.label: Legacy Mode. Your level persists between runs. Complete dungeons to raise the dungeon tier. Build one character over a long time.

parts.text: • Your level carries over between runs
• Complete dungeon → Dungeon Tier goes up
• Higher tiers = stronger enemies, better loot
• Die → keep your level, dungeon resets to Tier 1
• Build the same character over weeks

extras.text: Classic Run selected. You will start fresh every time you descend.

steps.heading: Step 8 of 12 — Spirit Companion
steps.title: Choose Your Spirit
steps.desc: A spirit companion fights alongside you. You keep the same spirit for this entire character's life. Rare and elite spirits you've unlocked appear here too.

steps.heading: Step 9 of 12 — Optional
steps.title: Corruption Mode
steps.desc: Every time you die, your character gains corruption. At 25% enemies begin to whisper. At 50% a Corrupted hunter stalks you. At 75% your skills backfire. At 100% you enter a legendary Corruption Run with massive rewards. This is for hardcore players.

cards.label: Corruption off. Normal gameplay.

parts.text: Normal gameplay. Death has no lasting effect on your character's soul.

cards.label: Corruption on. Death adds corruption to your character.

parts.text: Every death darkens your soul. Survive long enough and the dungeon will fear you.

steps.heading: Step 10 of 12 — Optional
steps.title: Hunter Mode
steps.desc: A relentless hunter stalks you through the dungeon. Every move you make, it moves too. Every turn you waste, it gets closer. If it reaches you — instant death. No second chances.

cards.label: Hunter Mode off. Normal gameplay.

parts.text: Standard dungeon. No one is hunting you.

cards.label: Hunter Mode on. A hunter will stalk you through the dungeon.

parts.text: Something is coming. It will not stop.

steps.heading: Step 11 of 12 — Optional
steps.title: Your Guide
steps.desc: She will walk with you through every dungeon. Give her a name and choose her personality.

extras.text: Your Guide She will walk with you through every dungeon. What will you call her?
Your Guide She will walk with you through every dungeon. What will you call her?
She will walk with you through every dungeon. What will you call her?

steps.heading: Step 12 of 12 — Optional
steps.title: Your Origin
steps.desc: Where did you come from? Grants a small bonus and writes your first journal entry. Skip to descend immediately.

descs.Tinkerer: 2 Free Potions · Skills Cost 2 Less SP

starter.name: Ember Fox
starter.ability: Attacks each turn for 15% of your base attack as fire damage.
starter.desc: A fox wreathed in embers. Attacks with you every turn.

starter.name: Bone Hound
starter.ability: Attacks for 20% base damage. +10% bonus vs undead enemies.
starter.desc: An undead hound bound to your will. Stronger against undead.

starter.name: Frost Sprite
starter.ability: At combat start reduces enemy attack 10% for 3 turns. Detects traps.
starter.desc: A tiny ice spirit. Slows enemies and detects traps.

starter.name: Shadow Crow
starter.ability: Each kill grants +3 bonus gold stolen by the crow.
starter.desc: A shadowy crow that steals gold from fallen enemies.

starter.name: Stone Turtle
starter.ability: At combat start creates a shell absorbing up to 15 damage.
starter.desc: Ancient and unbreakable. Absorbs the first hit of every combat.

starter.name: Thunder Moth
starter.ability: Each attack has a 20% chance to stun the enemy for 1 turn.
starter.desc: A moth charged with static. Has a chance to stun on attack.

starter.name: Market Sprite
starter.ability: All shop items cost 20% less this run. Costs 50 gold to reactivate next run.
starter.desc: A spirit bound to commerce. Negotiates on your behalf at every shop.

rare.name: Bone Hound Prime
rare.ability: Attacks for 25% damage each turn. On kill steals 5 SP.
rare.desc: The alpha undead hound. Drains SP from fallen enemies.

rare.name: Inferno Hawk
rare.ability: Attacks every turn for 30% fire damage. Burns enemy on combat start.
rare.desc: A hawk born from Vel Ashara's eternal fire.

rare.name: Glacial Wolf
rare.ability: At combat start grants +4 defense. Attacks for 20% damage, may freeze.
rare.desc: A wolf of ancient ice. Freezes enemies and grants defense.

rare.name: Void Wraith
rare.ability: Attacks for 35% damage each turn. Steals 8 HP from enemy on each hit.
rare.desc: A wraith from beyond reality. Drains life to heal you.

rare.name: Crystal Serpent
rare.ability: At combat start applies 4-turn frost poison. Attacks for 18% damage.
rare.desc: A serpent of living ice. Poisons enemies with frost venom.

rare.name: Ash Phoenix
rare.ability: Each kill restores 12 HP. Attacks for 22% fire damage.
rare.desc: Reborn from Vel Ashara's fire. Restores HP when you kill.

rare.name: Shadow Stalker
rare.ability: At combat start reduces enemy attack by 20%. Attacks for 15% damage.
rare.desc: A spider of pure shadow. Weakens enemies on combat start.

rare.name: Grave Hound
rare.ability: Attacks for 25% damage. At combat start reduces enemy attack by 15%.
rare.desc: A spirit hound from the Hollow. Guards you and strikes hard.

rare.name: The Lantern
rare.ability: Detects traps like Frost Sprite. Each kill grants +5 gold.
rare.desc: A warm light that guides and protects. Reveals traps and rewards exploration.

rare.name: Medusa
rare.ability: Serpent Guard — absorbs one enemy attack per combat.
rare.desc: Found at last. She guards those who showed her mercy.

rare.name: Easter Bunny
rare.ability: Each kill has a 20% chance to find an Easter Egg that restores 10 HP.
rare.desc: A spirit companion found only during Easter. Hops alongside you and finds hidden treats.

rare.name: Void Moth
rare.ability: Attacks for 35% damage. 15% chance to negate incoming damage each hit.
rare.desc: A moth of pure void. Attacks relentlessly and sometimes negates damage.

elite.name: Knight Shade
elite.ability: Attacks for 30% damage every turn. On kill restores 5 HP.
elite.desc: The spirit of a fallen Death Knight. Powerful and relentless.

elite.name: Titan Ember
elite.ability: At combat start applies 3-turn burn. Attacks for 25% fire damage.
elite.desc: The essence of an Ash Titan. Burns with eternal fury.

elite.name: Frost Crown
elite.ability: Grants +5 defense at combat start. Attacks for 20% ice damage.
elite.desc: A crown of living ice from the Frost Sovereign.

elite.name: Archive Phantom
elite.ability: Attacks for 28% damage. Each hit reduces enemy defense by 1.
elite.desc: The ghost of a drowned archivist. Knows every weakness.

elite.name: Void Herald
elite.ability: Attacks for 40% damage every turn. Requires level 7.
elite.desc: A fragment of the Void Champion. Terrifyingly powerful.

backstories.name: Exiled Noble
backstories.desc: Cast out from court. The dungeon is preferable to the shame.
backstories.journal: I was a noble once. The title meant something. The dungeon does not care about titles.

backstories.name: Cursed Wanderer
backstories.desc: Something followed you home. You went to the dungeon to lose it.
backstories.journal: The curse has been with me since the crossroads. Maybe the dungeon will take it instead of me.

backstories.name: Former Soldier
backstories.desc: The war ended. The fighting did not.
backstories.journal: Fifteen years of orders. Now there are no orders. I choose the dungeon.

backstories.name: Lost Scholar
backstories.desc: You read about the dungeon in seventeen books. None of them helped.
backstories.journal: I have studied every known account of the descent. Theory, I am finding, is different from practice.

backstories.name: Debt Collector
backstories.desc: The dungeon owes someone money. You are here to collect.
backstories.journal: The client said the dungeon has treasure. The client did not say what the dungeon has in return.

backstories.name: True Believer
backstories.desc: Your faith is absolute. The dungeon will test it.
backstories.journal: I believe I will survive. The dungeon does not know this yet.

backstories.name: Nobody Special
backstories.desc: No dramatic backstory. Just someone who opened the door.
backstories.journal: I am not here for glory or treasure or redemption. I am here because I opened the door and kept walking.

backstories.name: Last Hope
backstories.desc: Everything was tried. The dungeon is what remains.
backstories.journal: This is the last option available to me. I am aware of the odds.
